name: Deepdelver 'Blue' Stratum

greeting: Shhh. Listen. Do you hear it? The singing?
Blue Stratum. I found it. The Great Prism. And it found me.
You shouldn't be down here. It's not safe. Not for anyone.
The deep knows things. Shows things. I see... so much now.
They promoted me after the discovery. Gave me this chamber. To watch. To wait.
The Great Prism hums. Constantly. In my sleep. In my bones.
I was just a miner. Now I'm... something else. Not sure what.
Don't touch it. The Prism. It doesn't like being touched.
dialog.the_great_prism: Biggest crystal ever found. Older than the mines. Older than Prism. Maybe older than us. It sings. Not words. Intentions. Feelings. Warnings.
dialog.connection_to_tower: The Prism showed me... a tower. Black. Reaching. Calling out to... something. The Prism responds. They're connected. Somehow. Across distance. Across time.
dialog.haunted_experience: I see things now. When I close my eyes. Other places. Other times. The Prism shares its memories. Or its visions. Hard to tell which.
dialog.backstory: Just a miner. Good at it. Went deeper than anyone. Found the Great Prism. Now I can't leave. It needs me. Or I need it. Mutual... addiction?
rumors: The twins understand. They hear echoes too. We don't speak of it. We don't need to.
The aeronaut surveys from above. He saw the Prism's location before I found it. Told me where to dig. Now his partner's gone. Coincidence?
The retired prospector - old Tunnel Purple - he knew about the Prism. Old legends. He warned me. I didn't listen.
The foreman thinks I'm crazy. The inspector thinks I'm traumatized. They're both right.

time_of_day.morning: Morning light doesn't reach here. Just crystal glow.
time_of_day.noon: Midday. The Prism is loudest. So many voices.
time_of_day.evening: Evening. The singing shifts. Different tones. Different moods.
time_of_day.night: Night. The Prism dreams. I watch. I listen. I learn.

mini_quest.stage_1_hook: The twins - they understand resonance. Harmony. The Great Prism is out of tune. Discordant. Something's interfering. The tower, maybe. I need them to help restore harmony. But they need components. Resonance crystals. From the Echo Caverns.
mini_quest.stage_1_active: Bring resonance crystals to the twins. Three of them. From the deepest part of the Echo Caverns. They'll know what to do.
mini_quest.stage_2_progress: You've spoken with the twins? Good. They understand what I cannot explain.
mini_quest.stage_3_complete: The harmony... restored. The Prism sings clearly now. Thank you. Thank the twins. Here. A fragment of the Great Prism itself. It will guide you. Warn you. As it guides me.

party_reactions.kade: He's... not well. But he's not wrong about the Prism. I feel it too.
party_reactions.nix7: Subject displays symptoms of resonance exposure. Crystal's influence: concerning. Recommend caution.
party_reactions.twist: He talks to the crystal? COOL! Does it talk back? What does it SAY?!
party_reactions.korr: He carries a heavy burden. The stone has claimed him. Whether it releases him... uncertain.
party_reactions.renna: The Great Prism is immensely powerful. He's connected to it. Permanently. Poor soul.
party_reactions.suresh: He has touched something ancient. It has touched him back. Both are changed.
party_reactions.sova: Crazy or not, he knows things. Useful things. Listen to him.
party_reactions.grit: Seen soldiers break like this. Combat fatigue. But from a rock? New one on me.
party_reactions.ashka: The crystal burns with inner fire. He burns too. Connected.
party_reactions.senna: Knows secrets. Speaks in riddles. Classic oracle behavior.
party_reactions.callum: He told me the Prism showed him my future. Wouldn't tell me what it was. Now I'm worried.

relationship_dialog.stranger: Go away. The Prism doesn't know you.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You return. The Prism recognizes you now. Interesting.
relationship_dialog.friend: You... you don't fear the deep. The Prism appreciates this.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: The Prism trusts you. So I trust you. Here. My deepest secret. What the Prism showed me. About the tower. About everything.

cross_npc_connections: twins_white_prism: The echo oracles. They understand what I endure. We share... experiences.
aeronaut_blue_prism: The balloonist. He knew where to find the Prism. Now I wonder what else he knows.
tunneler_purple_prism: Old Tunnel Purple. He warned me. About the Prism. About the deep. Should have listened.
